tools.name: get_firm_overview
tools.description: What The Landing Company of Madison Park is, who it helps, who does the work, where it is based, and how to start.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The services the firm offers, each with the situations it fits and what the work involves. Optionally limit to services for companies and engineering teams, or for local small businesses.

tools.name: get_approach
tools.description: How an engagement runs, from understanding the problem to handing the work back.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions, including whether an independent consultant or a larger firm is the better fit.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Short practical guides the firm has written on difficult technology decisions. Returns each guide’s slug and the question it answers.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one guide, by slug from list_guides (a guide’s URL or title also works). Call with no slug to list the guides.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Sends The Landing Company a request for a 30-minute call with Campion Fellin, with the person’s name, email, problem description, and optionally company and availability. It does not book a time: the reply comes by email within one business day.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_guide · Public sink: request_consultation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_guide · Public sink: request_consultation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The full text of one guide, by slug from list_guides." → after: "The full text of one guide, by slug from list_guides (a guide’s URL or title also works). Call with no slug to list the guides."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
